script:
# Inspect the CSV file structure
csv_path <- "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv"
con <- file(csv_path, "r")
header1 <- readLines(con, n = 1)
header2 <- readLines(con, n = 1)
close(con)
cat("Header row 1 (group labels):\n")
print(header1)
cat("\nHeader row 2 (sample IDs):\n")
print(header2)
# Count total lines
total_lines <- length(readLines(csv_path))
cat("\nTotal lines (incl. 2 header rows):", total_lines, "\n")
cat("Number of genes:", total_lines - 2, "\n")

# Inspect the XLSX file structure
library(readxl)
xlsx_path <- "inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx"
sheets <- excel_sheets(xlsx_path)
cat("Sheets in XLSX:", paste(sheets, collapse = ", "), "\n")
for (s in sheets) {
  cat("\n--- Sheet:", s, "---\n")
  df <- read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = s, n_max = 3)
  cat("Columns:\n")
  print(colnames(df))
  cat("\nFirst few rows:\n")
  print(df)
  cat("\nTotal rows in sheet:", nrow(read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = s)), "\n")
}

# Load data
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
# Read expression data (CSV with 2 header rows)
csv_path <- "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv"
expr_data <- read.csv(csv_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, skip = 1)
# After skip=1, the column names are now the sample IDs row
# Let me re-read properly
expr_data <- read.csv(csv_path, skip = 2, header = FALSE)
colnames(expr_data) <- c("id", "CohortActrl1","CohortActrl2","CohortActrl4","CohortAsi1","CohortAsi2","CohortAsi5",
                         "CohortBctrl1","CohortBctrl2","CohortBctrl4","CohortBsi1","CohortBsi2","CohortBsi3")
cat("Expression data dimensions:", dim(expr_data), "\n")
cat("First gene IDs:\n")
print(head(expr_data$id, 5))
cat("\nCheck for duplicates:\n")
print(head(expr_data[duplicated(expr_data$id) | duplicated(expr_data$id, fromLast = TRUE), ], 3))
# Read differential analysis results
diff_data <- read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx")
cat("\nDifferential analysis dimensions:", dim(diff_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(colnames(diff_data), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("\nSummary of log2FoldChange:\n")
print(summary(diff_data$log2FoldChange))
cat("\nSummary of pvalue:\n")
print(summary(diff_data$pvalue))

# Prepare data for diagonal volcano plot
library(dplyr)
# Merge and prepare
plot_data <- diff_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange) & !is.na(pvalue)) %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p = -log10(pvalue),
    # Classify genes
    sig = case_when(
      pvalue < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Up-regulated",
      pvalue < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Down-regulated",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),
    # For diagonal layout: assign panel based on direction
    panel = ifelse(log2FoldChange >= 0, "Up (right)", "Down (left)")
  )
cat("Total genes with valid data:", nrow(plot_data), "\n")
cat("Significant up-regulated:", sum(plot_data$sig == "Up-regulated"), "\n")
cat("Significant down-regulated:", sum(plot_data$sig == "Down-regulated"), "\n")
cat("Not significant:", sum(plot_data$sig == "NS"), "\n")
cat("\nTop 5 up-regulated:\n")
print(plot_data %>% filter(sig == "Up-regulated") %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% head(5))
cat("\nTop 5 down-regulated:\n")
print(plot_data %>% filter(sig == "Down-regulated") %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% head(5))

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
# Cap -log10(p) to avoid Inf
max_p_cap <- 350
plot_data_clean <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p = pmin(neg_log10_p, max_p_cap),
    abs_log2FC = abs(log2FoldChange),
    direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange >= 0, "Up", "Down")
  )
# Identify top genes to label
top_up <- plot_data_clean %>%
  filter(sig == "Up-regulated") %>%
  arrange(pvalue) %>%
  head(10)
top_down <- plot_data_clean %>%
  filter(sig == "Down-regulated") %>%
  arrange(pvalue) %>%
  head(10)
# Create diagonal volcano plot using abs(log2FC) on x-axis
p <- ggplot(plot_data_clean, aes(x = abs_log2FC, y = neg_log10_p, color = sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.2) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = bind_rows(top_up, top_down),
    aes(label = id),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    segment.color = "grey40",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Up-regulated" = "#E74C3C", "Down-regulated" = "#3498DB", "NS" = "grey75"),
    labels = c("Up-regulated", "Down-regulated", "Not significant")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Diagonal Volcano Plot",
    subtitle = "Differential expression analysis (group2 vs group1)",
    x = expression("|" * log[2] * "Fold Change" * "|"),
    y = expression(-log[10] * "(p-value)"),
    color = "Significance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, color = "grey30"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 4, y = max_p_cap * 0.97, 
           label = paste0("Up: ", sum(plot_data_clean$sig == "Up-regulated")),
           color = "#E74C3C", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 4, y = max_p_cap * 0.92,
           label = paste0("Down: ", sum(plot_data_clean$sig == "Down-regulated")),
           color = "#3498DB", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5)
ggsave("diagonal_volcano_plot.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
cat("Plot saved.\n")
cat("File size:", round(file.info("diagonal_volcano_plot.png")$size / 1024, 1), "KB\n")
